items.title: ADI Stock Couldn't Defy Gravity Of Chip Sector For Long
items.summary: ADI showed relative strength and bucked the weakness in the chip sector. But we still took our profits quickly while we could.

items.title: FIVN Q3 Earnings & Revenues Surpass Estimates, Both Increase Y/Y
items.summary: Five9 tops Q3 earnings and revenue estimates on 16% subscription growth, but gross margins narrow as it unveils a $325 million AI acquisition plan.

items.title: SYNA Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Miss on Weak Demand
items.summary: Synaptics' fiscal Q1 2027 earnings beat estimates, but revenues missed estimates amid weak demand and supply constraints. Edge AI initiatives gain momentum.

items.title: Unity Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Vector Strength and Margin Gains
items.summary: U's Q3 adjusted earnings rise 120% as AI-powered Vector revenues surge 126%, margins widen, and the company posts its first GAAP profit since its IPO.

items.title: Airbnb Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates as Booking Demand Accelerates
items.summary: Airbnb's Q3 2026 earnings beat estimates as bookings surge, margins expand, and AI improves efficiency, prompting a higher full-year revenue growth outlook.

items.title: AAOI Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong Datacenter and CATV Sales
items.summary: Applied Optoelectronics' Q3 earnings beat estimates as datacenter and CATV sales surge, driven by 800G demand and record broadband equipment shipments.

items.title: Datadog's Infrastructure Monitoring Tops $2B ARR in Q3, Revenues Beat
items.summary: DDOG's Infrastructure Monitoring surpasses $2B in ARR as Q3 revenues beat estimates, with broad-based growth, rising AI adoption and expanding platform usage.

items.title: Arrow Electronics Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Rise Y/Y
items.summary: ARW posts record Q3 earnings of $6.22 per share and revenues of $10.72 billion, beating guidance and consensus estimates.
